review_scope: Source evidence, declared page/cell coverage and uncertainty are in each detailed review; not an exit-code or hash quality oracle.

rows.summary: All four sheets and the visible grid survive; visibility and sheet-kind metadata are not represented.
All eight cells survive, but A2 loses its nonzero time. A3/A4 time precision survives.
All six grids survive; three Unicode strings change and a midnight datetime becomes a date. Cached formula results survive.
All nine cells survive; the A2:A3 vertical span is flattened.
All five strings survive as words, but every cell loses source whitespace or a line break.
A source paragraph and heading disappear; scientific-number glyphs change and charts become false tables. All 496 reviewed MMLU decimal scores remain.
Mathematical symbols/operators are replaced or fragmented; inset tables and surrounding prose interleave.
Tables 3 and 7 lose model identities and averages, duplicate score blocks and gain an extra column. The title and chart become false tables; several two-column sections interleave prose.
The numeric body is collapsed into one Markdown row and Q1 values are joined to labels, so the output cannot be used as a faithful table.
Fifty-five geography records become eleven multi-record rows, and the disclaimer is duplicated. The totals row retains its values.

The continued cost table loses the stabilizer action identity and $766,885 total while combining two rows. Three-column prose and the two notices on page 15 interleave. Raster procedure text is absent as declared by the receipt.
The main prose is substantially preserved in page order, but the errata table loses its four-column mapping and a boxed disclaimer is duplicated as a table.
Correctly refuses all five image-only pages without producing an empty success artifact or attempting OCR.
All compensation records and travel records collapse into two first-column cells; the seven-column table no longer connects records to their fields.
Four sheets and all exposed numeric chart-sheet values survive; hidden states and the chart object do not.
All six source values survive, including native integers and a multi-day duration.
All six exposed cells survive; three merged ranges and their blank extents through D4 do not.
All five cached numeric results survive in sheet order; formula expressions are absent by contract.
All 980 cell positions retain values; three notes change only whitespace. Fifteen merged ranges and multi-row header semantics are flattened.
All six source values survive, including dates and the multi-day duration.
All eight empty worksheets survive as ordered headings; no data table is invented.
All six grids survive, including leading blank A1; three Unicode strings are changed by ASCII sanitising.
The complete 2 by 2 text grid survives; this file contains no VBA part.
Both populated cells and all three sheet names survive; two empty sheets remain empty.
Three empty sheets remain ordered and empty; the existing VBA part is not carried.
The visible grid and all four sheet headings survive; the chart object and visibility metadata do not.
All six source values survive, including the multi-day duration; raw XML dates have no hidden time component.
All fifteen source cells survive with correct header/value alignment and quantities.
All six populated-grid positions survive; A1:B1, A2:A4 and B2:D4 spans are flattened.
All twelve source cells survive in both sheet grids, including 22.2222 and 12.5.
All 476 cell positions retain values; two notes change only whitespace. Eleven merged ranges and multi-row header semantics are flattened.
